subject: Consolidated onboarding/offboarding artifacts and redacted background summary for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Kate Lyons <kate@screenly.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: hire-ops@screenly.io
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding + leaver evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this — Screenly is working through the SIG/CAIQ and we need a concise packet proving personnel screening and training controls for a subset of employees (sample of ~10). Specifically the assessor has requested: 
- Completed security training logs (redacted PII ok)
- Background check attestations or hashes for the sample individuals
- Evidence of onboarding steps (account creation checklist) and leaver deprovision timestamps
- The company playbook or runbook describing onboarding/offboarding procedures (versioned)

Can you confirm which artifacts you can share, and whether you can provide redacted CSVs or PDFs suitable for external review? We have a HubSpot ticket HS-83219 opened for the audit.

If possible we'd like a deliverable by EOD next Tuesday (Aug 3). Also: a sample DocuSign envelope showing minimal PII redaction would be helpful for their evidence intake process.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Lyons
Security Assessments | Screenly Inc.

---
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lyons <kate@screenly.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding + leaver evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide a consolidated packet. High level plan and constraints below.

What we can provide (we will redact PII before sending):
- training-completion-redacted.csv — per-user training completion timestamps, course ids, and pass/fail (no SSNs, DOBs)
- background-attestation-summary.pdf — HR-signed attestations confirming background check vendor completed checks for the sample
- redacted-background-hashes.csv — cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of candidate background documents as an added attestation layer
- sample-user-record-redacted.json — sanitized joiner record showing role, start/end dates, last access date (no email addresses)
- onboard-deprovision-playbook-v3.pdf — internal playbook (versioned) describing account provisioning and deprovision flows
- docusign-envelope-sample.pdf — sample envelope with PII redacted for the assessor to validate redaction approach
- deprovision-activity.log — system log extract showing automated deprovision timestamps for a sample user set (timestamps only)

Open items / timeline:
- HR needs to perform manual redaction on background check excerpts. Neha, can you confirm availability to produce the redacted CSV by EOD Aug 2?
- We will not provide raw SSNs or raw background vendor files; instead we will provide attestation + hashes. Is that acceptable to your assessor?

If that sounds okay I will assemble a .zip and upload to the shared Drive link and attach a short manifest.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Manager, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (placeholders) training-completion-redacted.csv; background-attestation-summary.pdf; deprovision-activity.log

- redacted-background-hashes.csv — lists employee IDs (internal short ids) + background hash + vendor attest date
- training-completion-redacted.csv — name replaced with employee-id-###, course id, completion datetime, pass/fail flag

Notes and controls:
- Background vendor: HireStream (contracted); we will provide attestations signed by HR and a vendor confirmation letter. We will not provide raw vendor PII.
- Sample size: I pulled 12 individuals across orgs (ENG, SRE, CS, Sales) to give coverage.

Kate — is providing hashes + HR-signed attestations acceptable, or does the assessor require raw vendor reports? If they require raw vendor reports, we'll need a signed non-disclosure + a narrow consent process from the affected employees.

Timeline: I ran redactions today and can share the Drive packet by EOD Aug 3.

Neha Kapoor
